13. (Currently amended) A flexible respiratory gas tube arrangement for supplying a respiratory gas to a person, the tube arrangement comprising: a flexible tube; a heater to heat the gas as it is delivered through the tube; a first connector provided to one end of the tube and adapted to connect the tube with a breathing mask; and a second connector provided to the other end of the tube and adapted to connect the tube with a CPAP device, said second connector including a first portion that provides a respiratory gas passage and a second portion that provides integrated contact elements positioned __non-coaxially with respect to the gas passage__ by which power is supplied to said heater, wherein said contact elements are adapted to be engaged with a power supply provided on the CPAP device for supplying power to said heater.

14. (Currently amended) The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, further comprising an insulating sheathing body __that is structurally distinct from the flexible tube and the second connector__.

15. (Currently amended) The gas tube arrangement according to claim 14, wherein the insulating sheathing body is removably attachable to the flexible tube __via mechanical fastening means__.

16. (Cancelled)

17. (Currently amended) The gas tube arrangement according to claim 14, wherein the sheathing body includes a multi-layered design __comprising at least one insulating layer and one structural support layer__.

18. (Currently amended) The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein the tube is a heatable respiratory gas tube __having heating elements integrated within the tube wall__.

19. (Currently amended) The gas tube arrangement according to claim 14, wherein the heater is integrated into the tube __and is electrically isolated from the contact elements of the second connector__.

24. (Currently amended) The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein the flexible tube is made from a spirally reinforced plastic material __having a tensile strength of at least 5 MPa__.

25. (Currently amended) The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein the heater is an electrical resistance heater __comprising nichrome wire or similar high-resistance material__.

26. (Currently amended) The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein each contact element extends generally parallel to a longitudinal axis of the gas passage __and is positioned radially outward from the gas passage__ such that both an electric and pneumatic connection is provided when the connector is connected to the CPAP device.

27. (Currently amended) The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein each contact element is provided within the second portion.

28. (Currently amended) The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein the first portion is tubular and the second portion extends outwardly from the first portion __in a radial direction perpendicular to the longitudinal axis of the gas passage__.

29. (Currently amended) A connector for connecting a CPAP device to a respiratory gas tube arrangement for supplying a respiratory gas to a person, the respiratory gas tube arrangement including a heater, the connector comprising: a first portion that provides a respiratory gas passage; and a second portion that provides integrated contact elements positioned __non-coaxially with respect to the gas passage__ by which power is supplied to the heater, wherein each contact element extends generally parallel to a longitudinal axis of the gas passage __and is positioned radially outward from the gas passage__ such that both an electric and pneumatic connection is provided when the connector is connected to the CPAP device.

30. (Currently amended) A connector according to claim 29, wherein each contact element is provided within the second portion.

31. (Currently amended) A connector according to claim 29, wherein the first portion is tubular and the second portion extends outwardly from the first portion __in a radial direction perpendicular to the longitudinal axis of the gas passage__.
